risks.description: Delay in receiving production API credentials from the third‑party payment vendor, blocking backend integration and threatening the release date.
Chosen UI component library may not satisfy WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility requirements, potentially requiring rework of the onboarding dashboard.
Staging environment instability blocked QA regression testing for multiple days, delaying verification of new features.
Automated KYC document verification rejects valid government ID uploads due to image compression, blocking end‑to‑end onboarding.
Load testing on the payment flow has not yet been conducted, leaving performance risks unvalidated.
Backend integration remains behind schedule, increasing the risk of missing the end‑of‑month release.

delivery_forecast: The project is currently at risk of missing the end‑of‑month release. While the payment gateway credentials have been received and backend work is expected to finish soon, a critical KYC verification defect and earlier staging instability have delayed testing. These issues, combined with the remaining UI accessibility review, mean the project is not on track to meet the original 8‑week window.
